beats.headline: Left hand only
beats.text: Some NPCs regenerate in minutes, says Carl's book, and Growler Gary once woke in a pile of his own blood. While he sleeps, Mongo kills him and chomps off both arms at the elbow. Sorry, Gary, says Carl, and takes them. On the first rapid-response cart he puts one arm on the hand-shaped key console and it glows green; he weighs it down with a rock and crosses to the second, eight feet away, too far for one gnoll to reach both. Warning: You must use your left hand to activate the key. Back to the bar, says Donut. Gary, resurrected, is sober now, and Mongo kills him again. Within five minutes the first cart is running, and with its portal tuned Carl lifts a hand away to start the next one. The cart shuts off. Back to the bar.

beats.headline: Fourteen left hands
beats.text: Altogether they collect fourteen left hands from Growler Gary: twelve would have done, but Carl wants an extra pair in case they need to drive a seventh cart. Gary, sober now, because resurrection does that, fights back only the first few times. They are too strong for him. He hides in the back of the bar, huddled into the corner with his spear, whimpering like an injured dog. If you're sorry, he says on the fifth, why are you doing it? The floor of the back room is slick with blood.

beats.headline: One pair short
beats.text: With the tunnel sealed, the ghouls being generated at 72 stop heading for 36 and turn this way. Carl thinks once again of Growler Gary. They collected one extra pair of hands from the poor gnoll, but they are actually one pair short. He can't use the portal carts to protect the others, but he can use one to protect themselves. Help me position one of the carts on the track, he says. Then we gotta go talk to Gary again.

beats.headline: Still in place
beats.text: The interdiction cart hangs vertically from the crane like a prize fish on display, its front facing down, the scoop at the bottom of its portal scraping the marble floor. With chains anchoring it so it won't swing, Carl climbs his handmade ladder to the cockpit. He pats the two Growler Gary left hands to make sure they are still firmly in place, then turns on the portal and tunes it to the abyss.
